quiz.title: Database Security, Access Control & Backup Fundamentals
quiz.description: 30 questions strictly based on Data Protection, Backup Strategies (Full, Differential, Log), SQL Server Logins/Users/Roles, GRANT/REVOKE/DENY, Masking, Encryption, and Hashing.

question.text: What is copied during a FULL BACKUP?
question.option: Only data changed after the last backup

question.text: True or False: A Full Backup is very simple to restore, but is expensive in terms of storage space and time.
Which T-SQL command creates a Full Backup of a database?
What does a DIFFERENTIAL BACKUP copy?
question.option: Only data changed after the last FULL BACKUP
Only changes after the last incremental backup

question.text: Which option must be added to the BACKUP DATABASE command to create a Differential Backup?
True or False: A Differential Backup saves only the data modifications that occurred since the previous Differential Backup.
What are the main advantages of an Incremental / Transaction Log Backup?
question.option: It executes faster and occupies less storage space
It offers the fastest restore process
It creates a complete copy of the whole database

question.text: What is a major disadvantage of Incremental / Transaction Log Backups?
question.option: It uses too much disk space
It takes too long to execute

question.text: Which T-SQL command creates a Transaction Log / Incremental Backup?
question.option: CREATE LOG BACKUP [nume database] TO DISK [calea]

question.text: True or False: To gain access to a database, a user must first have an account on the database server called a LOGIN.
What is an account created on the database SERVER level called?
What is an account created INSIDE a specific database called?
Which statement correctly creates a server LOGIN named alice_login with a password?
Which T-SQL statement creates a database USER mapped to a server LOGIN?
question.option: CREATE USER alice_user FOR LOGIN alice_login
CREATE LOGIN alice_user FOR USER alice_login
ADD USER alice_user TO LOGIN alice_login
LINK USER alice_user WITH LOGIN alice_login

question.text: True or False: Creating a database USER automatically grants that user full administrative access to all tables in the database.
Which T-SQL command adds a database user (alice_user) as a member to a role (db_datareader)?
question.option: ALTER ROLE db_datareader ADD MEMBER alice_user
ADD USER alice_user TO ROLE db_datareader
UPDATE ROLE db_datareader SET MEMBER = alice_user

question.text: Which SQL statement is used to grant a right/permission on an object to a user?
What is the correct general syntax for a GRANT statement?
True or False: GRANT INSERT ON Student_Table TO user_vasea gives user_vasea the right to insert data into Student_Table.
What does adding WITH GRANT OPTION to a GRANT statement allow the user to do?
question.option: Allows the user to perform the action AND grant that right to other users
Automatically revokes the permission after 24 hours
Prevents the admin from revoking the permission
Grants access to all databases on the server

question.text: Which SQL command is used to WITHDRAW (retrace) a previously granted right?
What is the correct syntax to REVOKE INSERT on Student_Table from user_vasea?
question.option: REVOKE INSERT ON Student_Table FROM user_vasea
REVOKE INSERT ON Student_Table TO user_vasea
DENY INSERT ON Student_Table FROM user_vasea
DELETE INSERT ON Student_Table FOR user_vasea

question.text: Which SQL command explicitly FORBIDS / PROHIBITS an action for a user?
True or False: Executing REVOKE INSERT ON Student_Table FROM user_vasea explicitly forbids user_vasea from inheriting insert permissions through a role.
What is Data MASKING?
question.option: The process of hiding specific parts of data to protect sensitive info (irreversible)
Transforming text into ciphertext using a key
Generating a hash string from a password
Creating a full backup of the database

question.text: Replacing a phone number with '06******90' or 'And*****001' is an example of which technique?
What is Data ENCRYPTION?
question.option: Transforming readable data into ciphertext using an algorithm and a cryptographic key
Hiding partial digits of a card number

question.text: True or False: Data Masking is a reversible encryption technique that allows administrators to retrieve original sensitive values at any time using a key.
What is HASHING?
question.option: Passing data through an algorithm to generate an irreversible string of characters (hash)
Encrypting data with a symmetric key that can be decrypted
Masking middle characters of a string with asterisks

question.text: True or False: Hashing is an IRREVERSIBLE process, where passing the exact same text and algorithm will always produce the exact same hash output.
